problem: Offer a legal service people prefer to piracy while paying the labels.
title: Spotify launches in Europe with an invite-only free tier and paid Premium
context: Music labels worried that streaming would hurt sales and piracy was widespread.
decision_made: Offer a free ad-supported version by invitation only alongside a paid Premium subscription open to everyone.
action_taken: Launched on 7 October 2008 with the support of the four major labels and many independents.
observed_outcome: Not documented in the sources used.
lessons: Invite-only access to the free tier let the company control growth while it built label relationships.
limitations: Only the launch structure was checked. Several sources disagree on which countries were included at launch.

claims.claim_text: Spotify launched with a free ad-supported tier and a paid Premium subscription.
Free accounts were by invitation only while paid subscriptions were open to everyone.
